nodes.name: daily_with_order_simulation.yaml
nodes.summary: Example backtest system config running two EWMAC (8/32, 32/128) momentum rules on daily prices with an order-simulation overlay, using a $50k notional, 25% vol target, and a two-instrument (US10, SP500_micro) portfolio.
nodes.languageNotes: pysystemtrade config: trading_rules map each rule to a dotted Python function path plus data accessors and other_args; forecast_weights/instrument_weights and div multipliers control portfolio combination.

nodes.name: estimateexampleconfig.yaml
nodes.summary: Example config that enables estimation of forecast scalars, forecast weights, and instrument weights (rather than fixed values), wiring EWMAC8/16 and carry rules across EDOLLAR, US10, and BUND with a 16% vol target and GBP base currency.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets use_forecast_scale_estimates / use_forecast_weight_estimates / use_instrument_weight_estimates to True so the system fits these parameters from data instead of reading static weights.

nodes.name: exampleconfig.yaml
nodes.summary: Canonical fixed-parameter example config defining trading rules with explicit forecast caps, forecast weights, instrument weights, and diversification multipliers for the standard pysystemtrade demo system.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes fixed forecast/instrument weights with a forecast_weight_estimate block, serving as the baseline config referenced throughout the documentation and tests.

nodes.name: hourly_with_order_simulator.yaml
nodes.summary: Example backtest config mirroring the daily order-simulation system but driven on hourly data, applying two EWMAC rules with order simulation, a 25% vol target, and a two-instrument portfolio.
nodes.languageNotes: buffer_method set to 'none' for consistency with the order-simulation pathway; intended to demonstrate intraday execution simulation.

nodes.name: simplesystemconfig.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal example system config used in introductory tutorials, defining two EWMAC trading rules with fixed forecast and instrument weights, a 25% vol target, and a $50k notional capital base.
nodes.languageNotes: Simplest of the provided example configs; commonly loaded in getting-started notebooks to build a System object end to end.
